entities.summary: Aleksandr Alga (b. 1913-12-10, Küşki-Yaña Timbay) was a journalist or media commentator of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Küşki-Yaña Timbay. Known in the fields of poets & playwrights.
